items.title: DETENTION WITHOUT PHYSICAL EXAMINATION OF REFRIGERATED (NOT FROZEN WITH PROPER LABELING) RAW FISH AND FISHERY PRODUCTS IN REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING DUE TO THE POTENTIAL FOR CLOSTRIDIUM BOTULINUM TOXIN PRODUCTION
items.label: FDA import alert 16-125
items.detail: The U.S. FDA can detain these products from listed firms in Palau at the border (DWPE). Alert last updated 11/12/2026.
